arguments.command:
cd /workspace && timeout 175 python3 - <<'PY'
import base64, ipaddress, json, random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/deps')
import campaign, zstandard as zstd
DOC=ipaddress.IPv6Network('2001:db8::/32'); BASE=int(DOC.network_address)
HEADER=('type,id,revision,published,op,lease,event,probe,target,responder,result,service,attempt,payload')
rng=random.Random(5)
def net(i): return BASE + (i << 72)
leases=[{'id':'L%04d'%i,'prefix':str(ipaddress.IPv6Network((net(i+1),56))),'start':0,'end':10**12,
         'subnets':[0],'low_count':31} for i in range(2048)]
job={'version':3,'seed':'mx','leases':leases,'services':[{'id':'s','kind':'tcp'}],
     'queries':[10,20,30,40],'captures':[],'requests':[],'offers':[],'request_quotas':[],'offer_quotas':[]}
rows=[]
for k in range(200000):
    idx=rng.randrange(2048); iid=rng.randrange(1,32); target=net(idx+1)+iid
    rows.append(['icmp','r%d'%k,'0','5','put','L%04d'%idx,'1','0/i%d'%iid,str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(target)),
                 str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(target)),'echo','','',''])
blob=(HEADER+'\r\n'+'\r\n'.join(','.join(r) for r in rows)+'\r\n').encode()
comp=zstd.ZstdCompressor(level=3).compress(blob)
print('plain MB %.0f comp MB %.1f'%(len(blob)/1e6,len(comp)/1e6), file=sys.stderr)
job['captures']=[{'encoding':'zstd','chunks':[base64.b64encode(comp).decode()]}]
job['requests']=[{'id':'R%d'%i,'at':40,'lease':'L%04d'%i,'target':str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(net(i+1)+2)),
                  'service':'s','group':'Q'} for i in range(4096)]
job['request_quotas']=[{'id':'Q','parent':None,'capacity':4096}]
start=time.time(); out=campaign.audit(job)
print('elapsed %.1fs manifest %d rejected %d live %d active %d plan %d unresolved@q1 %d' % (
    time.time()-start, len(out['manifest']), len(out['rejected']),
    out['snapshots'][3]['ledger']['live'],
    sum(1 for r in out['active_requests'] if r['active']), out['plan']['resolved'],
    len(out['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]['unresolved'])))
PY
